prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Meet You!", "Click below to place your pet directly onto your desktop workspace.", "Summon Pet to Desktop", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
1: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are preparing high-resolution desktop animations for your companion.", "Estimated time remaining: 2 minutes", "Asset Generation Progress"]
2: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your new friend and choose their core temperament.", "You can change your pet's name anytime later in settings."]
3: ["Begin Your Companion Journey", "Scroll through the story to choose how you want to create your companion.", "Select Quick Preset or Custom Creation"]
4: ["Save Your Companion Progress", "Sign in to keep your pet safe and sync across all your devices.", "Cloud save protects your pet customizations automatically.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
5: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Swipe or click to inspect companions and pick your favorite companion."]
6: ["Ready for Desktop Launch", "Your settings are configured and your pet is ready to join your workspace."]
7: ["How Would You Like to Adopt Your Pet?", "Pick 'Instant Friend' for instant ready-made companions, or 'Custom Pet' to generate a unique AI pet from your photos.", "Instant pets take 10 seconds. Custom pets take about 2 minutes."]
8: ["Signing in links your existing account and protects custom pet data from being lost."]
9: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "While we assemble your pet's animations, learn how to interact with your new desktop buddy.", "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open quick interactions.", "Early Adopter Care Bonus"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos to generate the pet.
Mentions a bonus or free extra ('Early Adopter Care Bonus').
